title: Martha Lou with Baby, California Palm Tree - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: Martha Lou holding him. she lives where Rose did. Wilma.
description: A sunny outdoor snapshot showing a young woman, identified in handwriting on the back as Martha Lou, holding a baby dressed in white. Standing beside a vintage baby carriage with a hanging rattle, she wears a mid-century short-sleeved plaid dress. Behind them rises a tall shaggy palm tree characteristic of Southern California or the American Southwest, set against an open residential landscape under bright midday sun.
